# Calculations
def filter_data(data: list[dict[str, ...]], query: dict[str, ...]):
    filtered = [
        elem
        for elem in data
        if (
            elem["n_sets"] == query["n_sets"]
            and elem["overcap"] >= query["overcap"]
            and all(elem["levels"][idx] >= query["levels"][idx] for idx in range(6))
        )
    ]
    return filtered


def render_gem_to_str(gem_info_list: list) -> str:
    # gem info
    # {
    #     "multiplier": 2.0,
    #     "tier": 3,
    #     "count": 1
    # },
    ans = ", ".join(
        [
            f"{'*' if elem['multiplier'] == 2.0 else ''}T{elem['tier']}{'*' if elem['multiplier'] == 2.0 else ''}"
            for elem in gem_info_list
            for _ in range(elem["count"])
        ]
    )
    return ans


with ui.sidebar(title="Set query parameters"):
    ui.input_select("n_sets", "Number of sets:", choices=list(range(0, 4 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_1", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_2", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_3", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_4", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_5", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_select("level_6", "Gem Trait Level", choices=list(range(0, 10 + 1)))
    ui.input_slider("overcap", "Overcap power", min=0, max=1000, value=0, step=50)
    ui.input_checkbox("show_assignments", "Show gem assignments", False)


with ui.card():
    ui.card_header("Optimal gem setups matching the query")

    @render.data_frame
    def optimal_gems():
        query = {
            "n_sets": int(input.n_sets()),
            "levels": sorted(
                [
                    int(input.level_1()),
                    int(input.level_2()),
                    int(input.level_3()),
                    int(input.level_4()),
                    int(input.level_5()),
                    int(input.level_6()),
                ],
                reverse=True,
            ),
            "overcap": int(input.overcap()),
        }
        filtered = filter_data(data, query)
        display = [
            {
                **{
                    "Gem Trait Level 1": elem["levels"][0],
                    "Gem Trait Level 2": elem["levels"][1],
                    "Gem Trait Level 3": elem["levels"][2],
                    "Gem Trait Level 4": elem["levels"][3],
                    "Gem Trait Level 5": elem["levels"][4],
                    "Gem Trait Level 6": elem["levels"][5],
                    "Overcap power": elem["overcap"],
                },
                **(
                    {
                        "Assignments 1": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["0"]),
                        "Assignments 2": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["1"]) if "1" in elem["gems"] else "",
                        "Assignments 3": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["2"]) if "2" in elem["gems"] else "",
                        "Assignments 4": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["3"]) if "3" in elem["gems"] else "",
                        "Assignments 5": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["4"]) if "4" in elem["gems"] else "",
                        "Assignments 6": render_gem_to_str(elem["gems"]["5"]) if "5" in elem["gems"] else "",
                    }
                    if input.show_assignments()
                    else {}
                ),
            }
            for elem in filtered
        ]
        return pd.DataFrame(display)
